arguments.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. One isolated Cartoon game biplane sprite. Image 1 is exact pose and silhouette authority; image 2 is ONLY the same aircraft identity and rendering materials, not the requested camera. Oblique front quarter view: tail far UPPER LEFT, fuselage runs diagonally toward nose LOWER RIGHT, nose/propeller nearest viewer at lower-right. Preserve the strong diagonal red wing crossing from lower-left toward upper-right, interplane struts and gray front propeller, olive fuselage. The tail is foreshortened, not a long side profile. Same red wings/tail, olive-green fuselage, dark tires/struts, gray metal and crisp black ink with simple cel shading as image 2. Preserve source extent and each visible part; no pilot/person, no extra aircraft, symbols or text. Genuine transparent RGBA background, generous clear padding on all four sides; no scenery, floor, shadow or glow. One sprite only.
